name: When should I consider resurfacing my pool deck?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider resurfacing my pool deck?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider resurfacing your pool deck if you notice visible cracks, spalling, discoloration, or a rough, uneven surface that could pose a tripping hazard. Also, if your deck is consistently hot to the touch, or if you simply want to update its aesthetic appeal and increase your property value, resurfacing is a good option. Addressing these issues early can prevent more extensive and costly repairs later.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider resurfacing if you see cracks, discoloration, an uneven surface, or if you want to improve appearance and safety.
